welcome.Subtitle: Free tools to study faster and smarter
welcome.KeyFeatures: What you can do with it
welcome.block1: From messy notes to quick sketches: turn them into interactive flashcards, quizzes and visual study sets. STUDO keeps it simple and fast — less hassle, more learning.
welcome.block2: Hey, I'm Charles. Full-time student and creator of STUDO. I was fed up: apps full of paywalls, unnecessary features and slow interfaces. So I built something better. Every feature has a purpose, nothing gets in the way.
welcome.block3: Whether it's vocab, formulas or entire chapters, STUDO adapts to your way of learning. Smart practice modes and repetition make things stick. And soon you'll take everything with you in your pocket with our iOS app.

about-us.title: About us
about-us.intro1: Hey. We are the developers behind STUDO — also students. The app was born out of frustration with existing study tools: too many unnecessary features, too many paywalls, and too little focus on what actually works.
about-us.intro2: We wanted something clean, fast and distraction-free, so we built it ourselves. What started as a side project has grown into something we're proud of.
about-us.intro3: STUDO is exactly what you need to study smarter: no hidden costs, no unnecessary extras, just powerful tools that work. Every feature solves a real problem.
about-us.storyText1: It started during a busy exam period. We were juggling multiple subjects, trying out all kinds of study apps and kept getting disappointed. Some were packed with features nobody uses. Others locked basic functionality behind expensive subscriptions. And most felt like they weren't made by people who are still students.
about-us.storyText2: So we opened our laptops and started coding. The first version was simple — just flashcards and a quiz. But it worked. From there, STUDO kept growing, driven by our own study needs and feedback from friends who started using it.
about-us.differentText: There are plenty of study apps. Here's what makes STUDO different:
about-us.different1: Studosets: our own take on flashcards with multiple built-in study modes
about-us.different2: Visualsets: learning with images via pins and point features
about-us.different3: Speedy mode: test your knowledge under time pressure
about-us.different4: No ads, no distractions — just you and your study material
about-us.different5: 100% free core features — learning shouldn't have a paywall
about-us.listenText1: Because we're still small, your feedback has a direct impact on the future of the app. Got an idea, feature request or bug? Send it our way. Every suggestion gets read and many of them make it into the app.
about-us.listenText2: STUDO grows with its users — every suggestion makes it better for everyone.
about-us.goingText1: STUDO is currently a small, indie project. But the goal is clear: become the go-to study app for students without compromising on simplicity or accessibility.
about-us.goingText2: With your support we can grow while staying true to our core mission: making studying smarter and less stressful. We don't want to be everything for everyone. We just want to be really good at helping people learn.
about-us.iosText1: We're working on the first official STUDO iOS app. All core features are coming to iPhone and iPad, with the same focus on speed and simplicity.
about-us.iosText2: Study on the bus, in the library or right before an exam — STUDO is there. Release coming soon.
about-us.valuesIntro: Everything we build is guided by these principles:
about-us.value1Text: every feature is built with real student needs in mind, not metrics
about-us.value2Text: learning should be accessible to everyone, regardless of budget
about-us.value3Text: your input determines what we build next
about-us.value4Text: better to do five things well than fifty things mediocrely
about-us.value5Text: your data is yours — we don't sell it and don't use it for ads
about-us.teamText1: Right now, STUDO is a small team of students. We handle design, development, testing and support — all alongside a full-time student life. That also means we know exactly what students need.
about-us.teamText2: As STUDO grows, so does the team. But for now, when you reach out you're talking directly to the people who built the app.
about-us.thanksText: To everyone who uses STUDO, shares it with friends or sends feedback — thank you.
about-us.contactText: Found a bug, have an idea or just a question? Feel free to reach out:

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro1: Welcome to our FAQ. Here you'll find answers to the questions we get most often from students using or considering Studo.
faq.intro2: Can't find your question? No problem — at the bottom of this page you'll find how to reach us. We usually respond within 24 hours.

q1.question: What exactly is Studo?
q1.answer: Studo is an all-in-one study platform for students. Instead of switching between flashcard apps, note apps, planners and search engines, you'll find everything in one place: Studosets and Visualsets for active studying, Classrooms for collaboration, Flow to track your subjects, and SVEN, our AI coach, to help you where needed.

q2.question: Who is Studo for?
q2.answer: Primarily for students in higher education, but anyone who wants to learn is welcome. From secondary school to university, from medicine to law to computer science — Studo is built to work with any subject and any study style.

q3.question: What's the difference between Studo and other flashcard apps?
q3.answer: Flashcards are just one part of Studo. You also get Visualsets (ideal for anatomy or geography), a full tracking system via Flow, shared learning environments via Classrooms, and AI support via SVEN. It's not a standalone tool, but an ecosystem that grows with your studies.

q4.question: What languages is Studo available in?
q4.answer: We currently support Dutch, English, French and Spanish. We're working on more languages and actively listen to which ones our community needs most.

q5.question: Is there a mobile app?
q5.answer: Yes, we have an iOS app so you can study on the go. An Android version is on our roadmap.

q1.question: What are Studosets?
q1.answer: Studosets are term-definition pairs you can study in different ways. You can use them via Learn (spaced repetition that keeps testing you until you know everything), Time Attack (speed mode with rounds), or classic Flashcards. Every mode adapts to your level.

q2.question: What makes Visualsets unique?
q2.answer: Visualsets are designed for visual subjects like anatomy, biology and geography. You upload an image, place pins with definitions on it, and study via two modes: Identify (you type what the pin represents) or Point (the system gives a definition and you indicate the correct pin). Perfect for memorising structures and locations.

q3.question: How do I quickly create a Studoset?
q3.answer: You have several options. Enter terms one by one manually, import from a Word document or Excel file, or simply via copy-paste. For maths subjects there's Math Mode which correctly renders LaTeX formulas. You can also add images to your terms.

q4.question: What is Health Mode during studying?
q4.answer: Health Mode reminds you every 20 minutes to stand up for 2 minutes and look outside — the 20-20-2 rule. A small detail that makes a big difference for your eyes and back during long study sessions. There's also a built-in pomodoro timer for those who work in intervals.

q5.question: Can I make my sets public or private?
q5.answer: Your choice. Public sets are findable via our search function, which is handy if you want to share with fellow students or contribute to the community. Private sets are only visible to you or the people you invite.

q1.question: What are Classrooms?
q1.answer: Classrooms are shared learning environments where you can study, practise and share material together with others. There are three types: Official Classrooms (linked to a school or teacher), Study Groups (private groups with friends or project partners), and Communities (open public groups around a subject or topic).

q2.question: How do I join a Classroom?
q2.answer: For Official Classrooms and Study Groups you usually receive an invitation or a code from the organiser. Communities are open — find them via the search function and join directly.

q3.question: Can I see how others are progressing in a Classroom?
q3.answer: In Classrooms and Study Groups you can optionally see each other's progress and statistics, which is motivating for studying together. You can always turn this off entirely via your privacy settings — you decide what you share.

q4.question: What are competitions and challenges?
q4.answer: Within Classrooms and Study Groups someone can start a study competition that others can join. Ideal for memorising material together before an exam with a touch of competition.

q5.question: If my teacher creates a Classroom, can they see my performance?
q5.answer: In an Official Classroom your teacher or professor can follow your progress to give targeted feedback. This is communicated transparently and is tied to the Classroom itself — outside that context your statistics remain yours.

q1.question: What is Studo Flow?
q1.answer: Flow is our tracking system to visually manage your learning process. Organised by academic year, by subject and by learning activity. Think of it as a smart, visual version of the spreadsheet many students use to track what they've already covered — but with direct links to your studosets and visualsets.

q2.question: How does Flow work in practice?
q2.answer: Flow is built from three layers: Flowboards (your study year or semester), Flowcourses (each subject) and Flowrows (concrete learning activities like a lecture or exercise). During class you quickly type a title and press Enter — done. At home you can structure things: update status, set priority, link resources.

q3.question: Is Flow suitable if I'm not a planner type?
q3.answer: Absolutely. Flow is deliberately designed for both power users and students who do minimal planning. Entering a title is enough to get started. All extra fields like priority, type or deadline are optional. You can make it as simple or as detailed as you like.

q4.question: How do I see my progress?
q4.answer: At two levels. Per subject you see a progress bar at the top of the table view showing how many items you've completed. On the overview of your Flowboard each Flowcourse appears as a card with a compact progress bar — one glance and you know where you stand for each subject.

q1.question: What is SVEN?
q1.answer: SVEN is our AI coach and is part of Studo Select, the premium version of the platform. SVEN helps you get from course material to studyable content faster — think automatically generating Studosets from documents, or quickly looking something up in your course.

q2.question: Can SVEN automatically create sets from my course?
q2.answer: Yes. You upload a PDF or Word document and SVEN generates a Studoset with terms and definitions. You always stay in control — you can review, edit and give final approval to the AI output before the set is finalised. We never publish anything automatically.

q3.question: What is course linking?
q3.answer: When you link a course to a Studoset, a 'Check course' button appears next to each term that takes you directly to the relevant section. No more searching through hundreds of pages. You can also semantically search your uploaded courses by keywords or phrases.

q4.question: Is AI-generated content always correct?
q4.answer: AI sometimes makes mistakes, which is why you always see a disclaimer to review the output. We work with human review steps and a feedback loop where you can rate every AI output. Always verify important content yourself before studying with it.

q1.question: What are Studo Courses?
q1.answer: Studo Courses are pre-built learning paths curated by the Studo team itself to ensure quality. A Course (for example Medicine) consists of multiple Tracks — modules around a specific topic or exam — each linked to relevant subjects and verified sets.

q2.question: What does the Verified badge mean?
q2.answer: Sets with a Verified badge are created or reviewed by the Studo team, have proven 95%+ accuracy on exams, or are approved by a teacher. Verified sets get priority in search results and are featured on subject pages.

q3.question: Can I become a Verified creator?
q3.answer: Yes. If your sets meet the criteria, you receive Verified creator status. Benefits: Studo Select for free, a spot on the leaderboard of top creators, and in later phases a revenue share for popular sets.

q1.question: How do I create an account?
q1.answer: You can register with your email address, Google account or Microsoft account. It takes less than a minute and you have immediate access to the platform.

q2.question: Can I delete my account?
q2.answer: Of course. In your account settings you'll find the option to permanently delete your account. All your data will then be deleted in accordance with our privacy policy.

q3.question: What about privacy in Classrooms?
q3.answer: You decide what you share. Comparing progress and sharing statistics are optional and can be fully disabled via your settings. You can also set separate privacy preferences per Classroom.

q4.question: I forgot my password, what now?
q4.answer: Click 'Forgot password' on the login page, enter your email address and you'll receive a reset link. Also check your spam folder if the email doesn't arrive immediately.

q1.question: Is Studo free?
q1.answer: The core features of Studo are free: Studosets, Visualsets, Classrooms, Flow and search. The AI features are part of Studo Select, our premium tier.

q2.question: What do I get with Studo Select?
q2.answer: With Studo Select you get access to SVEN, our AI coach. In concrete terms: up to 8 GB of file uploads, automatic set generation from documents, course linking, semantic search within your courses, and 100 set credits for SVEN set generation.

q3.question: Can I cancel Studo Select at any time?
q3.answer: Absolutely. You can cancel at any time in your account settings. You retain access to the premium features until the end of the billing period.

q1.question: Which browsers are supported?
q1.answer: Studo works on all modern browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge. We recommend keeping your browser up to date for the best experience.

q2.question: Does Studo work offline?
q2.answer: Some features such as viewing downloaded Studosets work offline in the iOS app. The web version requires an internet connection for most features.

q3.question: How secure is my data?
q3.answer: We take privacy seriously. All your data is stored encrypted and we never sell your data to third parties. Read our privacy policy for all details.
